1.w: For the one directing. According to “Lilies.” A Testimony. Of Asaph. A Psalm. O Shepherd of Israel, Give ear! [The One] leading Joseph as a flock, dwelling [above] the cherubim, shine forth

2.w: before the face of Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh! Rouse Your strength, and come to bring salvation for us!

3.w: O God, restore us, and cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved!

4.w: O YHWH, God of Hosts, until when will You smolder at the prayer of Your people?

5.w: You have fed them the bread of tears, and caused them to drink with tears a third part.

6.w: You have made us a strife to our neighbors, and our enemies mock at it.

7.w: O God of Hosts, restore us, and cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved!

8.w: A vine from Egypt You pulled out; You drove out the nations and planted her.

9.w: You cleared before her face and let her root take root, and she filled the land.

10.w: The hills were covered with her shade, and the mighty cedars with her branches.

11.w: She sent out her branches to the Sea, and her shoots to the River.

12.w: Why have You broken down her walls, and all passing by the way pluck her fruit?

13.w: The boar from the forest tears at her, and the wild beast of the field feeds on her.

14.w: O God of Hosts, return, we pray! Look down from the heavens and see, and attend to this vine,

15.w: and the root that Your right hand has planted, and the son You have made strong for Yourself,

16.w: having been burned in the fire, having been cut down. May they perish at the rebuke of Your face!

17.w: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, upon the son of man You made strong for Yourself.

18.w: Then we will not turn back from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.

19.w: O YHWH, God of Hosts, restore us! Cause Your face to shine, and we shall be saved!
